# 2 Chronicles Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-went Rehoboam to-Shechem for to-Shechem came all Israel to-make-him-king.

**2** And-it-was as-heard Jeroboam son-of Nebat and-he was-in Egypt that he-fled from-before Solomon the-king and-he-returned Jeroboam from-Egypt.

**3** And-they-sent and-they-called to-him and-he-came Jeroboam and-all Israel and-they-spoke to Rehoboam saying

**4** your-father made-heavy our-yoke and-now lighten from-hard-service-of your-father and-from-his-yoke the-heavy that he-put upon-us and-we-will-serve-you.

**5** And-he-said to-them go-away for-three days and-return to-me and-the-people went.

**6** And-he-consulted the-king Rehoboam with the-elders who were standing before Solomon his-father in-his-being alive saying how are-you advising to-return to-this people a-word.

**7** And-they-spoke to-him saying if you-are good to this people and-you-please-them and-you-speak to-them words good then-they-will-be to-you servants all the-days.

**8** And-he-forsook the-counsel-of the-elders that they-counseled-him and-he-consulted with the-young-men who grew-up with-him who-were-standing before-him.

**9** And-he-said to-them what are-you advising and-we-shall-return a-word to-this people who spoke to-me saying lighten from the-yoke that put your-father upon-us.

**10** And-they-spoke to-him the-young-men who grew-up with-him saying thus you-shall-say to-the-people who spoke to-you saying your-father made-heavy our-yoke and-you lighten from-upon-us thus you-shall-say to-them my-little-finger is-thicker than-loins-of my-father.

**11** And-now my-father loaded upon-you a-yoke heavy and-I I-will-add upon your-yoke my-father disciplined-you with-the-whips and-I with-the-scorpions.

**12** And-he-came Jeroboam and-all the-people to Rehoboam on-the-day the-third as-that spoke the-king saying return to-me on-the-day the-third.

**13** And-he-answered-them the-king harshly and-he-forsook the-king Rehoboam the-counsel-of the-elders.

**14** And-he-spoke to-them according-to-counsel-of the-young-men saying my-father made-heavy your-yoke and-I I-will-add upon-it my-father disciplined-you with-the-whips and-I with-the-scorpions.

**15** And-not listened the-king to the-people for was the-turning from-with God so-that He-might-raise-up YHWH His-word that He-spoke by-hand-of Ahijah the-Shilonite to Jeroboam son-of Nebat.

**16** And-all Israel saw that not listened the-king to-them and-they-returned the-people to-the-king saying what portion-for-us in-David and-no inheritance in-son-of Jesse each-man to-your-tents Israel now see your-house David and-he-went all Israel to-his-tents.

**17** And-sons-of Israel the-dwelling in-cities-of Judah and-he-reigned over-them Rehoboam.

**18** And-he-sent the-king Rehoboam Hadoram who was-over the-forced-labor and-they-stoned him sons-of Israel stones and-he-died and-the-king Rehoboam hastened to-mount the-chariot to-flee to-Jerusalem.

**19** And-they-rebelled Israel against-house-of David to this day.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **10:10**: my-little-finger is-thicker — A boast of greater harshness. The young men's crude bravado contrasts sharply with the elders' measured wisdom.

- **10:15**: the-turning from-with God — The Chronicler explicitly attributes the political rupture to divine causation. God's sovereignty operates through human folly.

- **10:16**: what portion-for-us in-David — The secession cry echoes Sheba's rebellion (2 Samuel 20:1). The tribal fracture runs deep in Israel's history.


— EMET
